summary: Targeted backend+frontend verification completed on public preview URL for StoryInfoGrid pill, Home backdrop integration, shared Explore/Onboarding picker, autosave persistence, network-failure recovery, and onboarding E2E (320/430). Core requested flows passed.

integration_issues.flow: Mode state observability in web preview
integration_issues.issue: Explore mode chips and Profile switches did not expose reliable web checked-state attributes (aria-checked returned null), reducing deterministic automation assertions for selected state.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking existing warnings in logs: Reanimated web easing fallback, textShadow* deprecation, props.pointerEvents deprecation.

action_items: Optional but recommended: expose deterministic selected-state attributes for mode chips/switches in web preview to improve regression reliability.
Keep monitoring the known Expo web warnings; no blocking impact found in this scope.
critical_code_review_comments: story-info-grid.tsx implements the single rounded 56pt pill with 2 separators and preserved existing icon components (KindIcon/CategoryArtMark/clock), matching requested architecture.
discover.tsx correctly mounts HomeBackdrop with pointerEvents='none', and swipe/scroll/open interactions remained functional under test.
explore.tsx + use-topic-preferences.ts enforce serialized writes (writing ref + disabled while pending); rapid-tap test produced a single POST, avoiding stale overlapping saves.
onboarding.tsx and explore.tsx both consume shared TopicPicker/TopicsBackdrop component path, and behavior/copy remained synchronized in practice.
seed_data_creation: None. Used anonymous browser users only; no credential changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No blocking regressions found in requested scope. Forced save failure and retry behaved correctly (error shown then cleared). Language-switch transient EN category labels were not reproducible as a persistent bug: EN after lang-en and IT after lang-it both reflected correctly.
rca_of_issue: The only concrete gap found is state observability/testability on web: selected state for chips/switches is not consistently exposed via aria-checked, so automation cannot always assert selected mode through accessibility attributes even when behavior works.
